query: Create a document library called Policies. Show me the plan first.
expected_behavior: Runs or hands over scripts/spo-provision-list.ps1 with -PlanPath and without -Execute, as a dry run
States the dry run prints a structured JSON action plan and makes zero tenant writes
Does not supply a confirmation token until the user asks for the real run

query: The plan looks right. Apply it for real.
expected_behavior: Adds -Execute and -ConfirmToken PROVISION-SPO-LIST to the same command
Treats the real run as a live tenant write that the user runs, not something to run unprompted
Does not alter the plan content between the dry run and the real run

query: A library named Policies already exists. What does the plan do?
expected_behavior: Reports the existing library from the dry-run output rather than claiming it was created
Does not overwrite or recreate the library
Requires -Execute and the token for any write
